title: pm-dispatch: one review record per PR — ACCEPT and 速读终稿 merge into one PR comment, the card keeps a pointer; the landing record stays the probe table; the ledger block only at summon end (方案 6, 「同意」 2026-10-14)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`) under the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-10-14, chat) on the seat's proposal, verbatim: 「席位产物合并。ACCEPT 和速读终稿合成 PR 上一条记录，卡上只留指针；落地记录保持探针表；台账只在每场收工写一块。」, and under 「立卡你决定，不需要我同意」. Maintainer-directed charter change (Tier H: `.claude/**`); the PR stays a draft for the maintainer's merge. Lane: `domain:skills`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is measured

- Per card this summon: the claim, the dev report (6–10 KB), the ACCEPT on the card (4–6 KB), the 速读 终稿 on the PR, the landing record, a ledger block on the seat post: five or six prose artefacts by the seat, most of the ACCEPT restated in the 终稿 and again in the ledger.
- The maintainer reads the 终稿 on the PR; the card's ACCEPT is read by seats, who need the gates union, the deviations and the landing clause, not the prose.

## What changes (text only)

1. SKILL.md 速读 lines and `references/landing-operations.md`: the ACCEPT and the 终稿 are **one PR comment**: the five 速读 sections (Chinese, business angle) on top, then `## 席位核对` with what the ACCEPT carries today (PR shape, premises measured, gates as check-runs, deviations accepted, out-of-scope carried, the landing clause). The card gets one line: `ACCEPT → PR #n comment <id>` (the queue guard and the landing precheck read the PR record).
2. The landing record stays the probe table on `origin/main` plus the one-line state change; no restatement of the ACCEPT.
3. `references/lanes/director.md`: the summon ledger is one block at summon end (cards, authority, direction, state transitions), not one block per landing; a landing's record is the PR comment and the landing table.

## Acceptance

- The merged record's shape is in `record-recognisers.mjs --template` (or the reference's template) and the queue guard still finds the review of record on the PR; the rule sentences are quoted before and after; ratchet ceilings hold; lines ≤ 120 bytes; no model name.
- The next landed card shows one PR comment, one pointer line on the card, one probe table, and no per-landing ledger block.

## Constraints

- Tier H: draft only. `skip-changeset` applies. The `## Contract review` record (a different record, the at-tier review) is untouched.
